AP.coverage: No positive or no negative slot remains missing for BOTH AP conventions, including C D300/stride300
AP.identity: For each edge AP_standard=AP_plus+prevalence*(1-positive_strength_recall). Average the product, not marginal means.
AP.positive: Old positive-change AP with zero-strength abstention, unchanged
AP.standard: Noninterpolated AP over every distinct score including final zero-strength group, whole-group ties

cases: Original A400 fits (Lasso/OLS), B300 and C300; 1000 fits from paired repeats. External validation fits are separate.

residual.credit: 1 for >, 0 for <, half for exact ties
residual.near_zero: 1e-8 is fixed finite-precision/tie-breaking diagnostic, not a fitted model choice
residual.pairs: positive/negative time pairs per nonself changing edge
residual.partition: candidate labels equal vs unequal; each component divided by that edge's ALL positive-negative pair count, then macro-averaged

role: Post hoc extension after observing all preceding A/B/C outcomes; not an independent confirmation

statistics.counts: Retained exactly, not bootstrapped; failures/undefined pairs remain explicit missing denominators
statistics.reuse: One repeat index matrix per cell/finite-mask, reused across metrics/methods/q/absolute and paired estimates via equivalent count weights
statistics.scope: 95% pointwise paired-repeat percentile intervals; no tests/families or multiplicity claim
statistics.streams: SeedSequence(seed, first4 little-endian u32 of SHA256(JSON(cell_identity, finite_mask)))

thresholds.interpretation: Fixed descriptive amplitude or method-relative reference, not independently calibrated false-positive rates; no best-q selection
thresholds.pool: All nonself edge-slot abs differences within one fit
